subject: R's SEXP type is changed within TMB

messages.author: adc8ca6cfb4e05df
messages.subject: R's SEXP type is changed within TMB
parts:
I'm learning how TMB handle R's objects,  whether I passed integer, logical R data type, the pointer to that data SEXP always recognized as double (i.e.need to access with `REAL`). It is easy to read the data but is there a way to not do this in order to have the type compatible with other purposes?

set.seed(2020)
x          <- seq(0, 10, length=1000)
data       <- list(x=x, z=as.integer(88), y=TRUE)
parameters <- list(a=0, b=1)

Cpp

#include <TMB.hpp>
template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() () {
    Type nll = 0.0;
    DATA_VECTOR(x);
    DATA_SCALAR(z);
    DATA_SCALAR(y);
    std::cout << z << ", " << y << std::endl;
    double * x2 = REAL(getListElement(this->data, "x"));
    int z2 = *INTEGER(getListElement(this->data, "z")); // this failed
    // int z2 = *INTEGER(getListElement(this->data, "z")); // this works
    // bool y2 = *LOGICAL(getListElement(this->data, "y")); // this will fail as well
    PARAMETER(a);
    PARAMETER(b);
    return nll;
}
